title: Schema-driven Form
description: Schema in, validated form out. FormRenderer reads a JSON-Schema-ish object and renders the right input per type, with built-in validation and dirty tracking.

tool.name: mount_form
tool.description: Mount a schema-driven FormRenderer on the canvas. Use when the user wants a form built from a JSON-Schema-ish object — sign-up, contact, settings, etc.

parameters.schema: JSON-Schema-ish object with `properties`; type + format + enum + required drive rendering and validation

props.name: schema
props.desc: JSON-Schema-ish object with `properties`; type + format + enum + required drive rendering

props.name: layout
props.desc: Optional layout tree — overrides default vertical stack

props.name: lookups
props.desc: Async/sync lookups keyed by JSON-Schema property path

props.name: renderers
props.desc: Custom renderer registry — keyed by renderer id

events.name: onsubmit
events.desc: Fires when validation passes and the user submits

events.name: oninvalid
events.desc: Fires when validation fails on submit
